card.name: Linking words in nerve-stimulation monitoring
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs (to, by, reduced, a, closing parenthesis) right before neuromuscular-block monitoring terms such as TOF stimulation, twitch response, or ED95 of a blocker.

modes.label: Link before TOF
modes.description: Word like 'to' or 'the' after 'twitch response' leading into TOF stimulus.
modes.example: first twitch response<< to>> the TOF stimulus is substantially greater than

modes.label: Closing bracket after TOF
modes.example: no twitch responses to train-of-four (TOF<<)>> stimulation. ( 2.2 )

modes.label: Verb before ED95
modes.description: The verb 'reduced' just before the ED95 of a muscle relaxant.
modes.example: before testing)<< reduced>> the ED 95 of succin

card.writes: It seems to push toward words like 'paired' and 'depression', as in paired stimulation or depressed twitch response.
